easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Repeat from step 6.
